verbatim_quotes.text: On September 2, 2026, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) posted presentation materials to its Investor Relations website titled “FY27 Segments and Investor Metrics” announcing a change in reportable segments and investor metrics. Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the Company will manage its operations under this updated reporting structure and report its financial performance based on two reportable segments: (1)Agents and Infra and (2)Devices and Consumer. A copy of the presentation materials is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this report.

shall not be deemed to be “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

Beginning with FY27, we will transition from our current three reporting segments, Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing, to two segments: Agents and Infra and Devices and Consumer.
We will transition to two reporting segments for FY27.

method_notes.timestamps: 每次尝试的 retrieved_utc 为真实读秒：发起前与返回后各读一次 UTC 系统时钟（yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ），记为窗口 [start,end]；harness web_fetch 不提供服务端时间戳，工位不伪造单点时刻。
method_notes.transcription_disclosure: harness web_fetch 只把响应文本放进上下文、不落盘；4 个语料文件 = 工位对该返回文本的逐字转写（UTF-8/LF/无 BOM）。sha256 对已写入字节计算。A4 的首次转写经 A21 独立再取逐段核对，修正了封面页 2 处段落；8 条引文全部在 path A / path B 两份文件中各自定位到字节区间。
method_notes.no_origin_bytes: SEC 原站直取 4 次全部 403（A1/A3；另 A8/A9/A17 raw 代理亦未成功），因此本地文件不含 origin HTML 字节；是否可称『申报原文本地归档』由会计面裁定。
method_notes.level_not_claimed: 本工位只交证据与形态，不作 E1/E2 等级判定（OWNER_DECISIONS §二十四 执行纪律：证据等级由会计面定，不由取证方自定）。
